```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# All genes that are present in the TCGA + ICGC BRCA OncoVar lists
# Have at least one structural variant (SV) in cohort

# ===============================
# Load libraries
# ===============================
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(stringr)
library(grid)

# ===============================
# SV color mapping
# ===============================
# For heatmap CELLS (keep Multi-Hit black)
col_fun_cell <- c(
  "Del" = "#E64B35",
  "Dup" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Inv" = "#3C5488",
  "Ins" = "#00A087",
  "Transloc-Inter" = "#F39B7F",
  "Transloc-Intra" = "#8491B4",
  "Multi-Hit" = "#000000"
)

# For BARPLOTS (NO Multi-Hit)
col_fun_bar <- c(
  "Del" = "#E64B35",
  "Dup" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Inv" = "#3C5488",
  "Ins" = "#00A087",
  "Transloc-Inter" = "#F39B7F",
  "Transloc-Intra" = "#8491B4"
)

# ===============================
# Load SV input data
# ===============================
df_raw <- fread("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/SV_df_unqiue_IPM.csv")
names(df_raw) <- str_trim(names(df_raw))

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  separate_rows(OverlapGenes, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(OverlapGenes = str_trim(OverlapGenes)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OverlapGenes), OverlapGenes != "", OverlapGenes != "-")
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Load and merge OncoVar annotations (TCGA + ICGC BRCA)
# ===============================
tcga_df <- fread("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/TCGA.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Source = "TCGA")

icgc_df <- fread("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/ICGC.BRCA.onco.genes.OncoVar.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Source = "ICGC")

combined_df <- bind_rows(tcga_df, icgc_df)

gene_roles <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(Gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    is_oncogene = any(str_detect(
      paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, Oncogene),
      regex("oncogene", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_tsg = any(str_detect(
      paste(OncoKB, OncoVar, `2020Rule`, CTAT, HCD, Intogen, TSgene),
      regex("tsg", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cancer_role = case_when(
      is_oncogene & !is_tsg ~ "Oncogene",
      is_tsg & !is_oncogene ~ "TSG",
      is_tsg & is_oncogene  ~ "Dual",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

metadata_cols <- c(
  "Gene_symbol", "Gene_biotype", "OncoKB", "OncoVar", "MutPanning",
  "2020Rule", "CTAT", "HCD", "Intogen", "Oncogene", "TSgene"
)

gene_metadata_full <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(Gene_symbol, desc(Source)) %>%
  distinct(Gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols))

cgc_df <- left_join(gene_roles, gene_metadata_full, by = "Gene_symbol") %>%
  rename(OverlapGenes = Gene_symbol)

cgc_genes <- unique(cgc_df$OverlapGenes)
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# SANITY CHECK BEFORE FILTERING
# ===============================
sample_match_df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    OverlapGenes_clean = gsub("-", "", OverlapGenes),
    in_combined = OverlapGenes_clean %in% gsub("-", "", cgc_genes)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total_gene_rows = n(),
    n_matching_gene_rows = sum(in_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_match = any(in_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(has_match), desc(n_matching_gene_rows), sample)

matched_samples <- sample_match_df %>% filter(has_match) %>% pull(sample)
unmatched_samples <- sample_match_df %>% filter(!has_match) %>% pull(sample)

cat("\n===============================\n")
cat("Sanity check: sample match to combined_df genes\n")
cat("===============================\n")
cat("Total unique samples in SV file:", n_distinct(df_raw$sample), "\n")
cat("Samples with >=1 SV in gene matched to combined_df:", length(matched_samples), "\n")
cat("Samples with NO SV in gene matched to combined_df:", length(unmatched_samples), "\n\n")

if (length(unmatched_samples) > 0) {
  cat("Samples with NO matched genes:\n")
  print(unmatched_samples)
} else {
  cat("All samples have at least one matched gene.\n")
}
```
```{r}
# ===============================
# Filter genes to curated BRCA list
# ===============================
df <- df_raw %>% filter(OverlapGenes %in% cgc_genes)

# Keep gene naming consistent between df_top and mat
df <- df %>% mutate(OverlapGenes = gsub("-", "", OverlapGenes))
df_top <- df

gene_metadata <- cgc_df %>%
  mutate(OverlapGenes = gsub("-", "", OverlapGenes)) %>%
  filter(OverlapGenes %in% unique(df_top$OverlapGenes))

# ===============================
# Build stable event_id ONCE (for event-level counts)
# ===============================
if (!"event_id" %in% names(df_top)) {
  if ("X.h.SmapEntryID" %in% names(df_top)) {
    df_top$event_id <- as.character(df_top$X.h.SmapEntryID)
  } else if (all(c("RefcontigID1", "RefcontigID2", "RefStartPos", "RefEndPos", "Type") %in% names(df_top))) {
    df_top$event_id <- paste(
      df_top$RefcontigID1, df_top$RefcontigID2,
      df_top$RefStartPos, df_top$RefEndPos, df_top$Type,
      sep = "|"
    )
  } else {
    df_top$event_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(df_top)))
  }
}

# ===============================
# Prepare matrix for heatmap CELLS (presence/type)
# ===============================
mat <- df_top %>%
  select(sample, OverlapGenes, Type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = Type,
    values_fn = function(x) paste(unique(x), collapse = ";")
  )

mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
rownames(mat) <- mat$OverlapGenes
mat$OverlapGenes <- NULL

# ===============================
# Sample order by total SV counts
# ===============================
sample_total_counts <- df_top %>%
  distinct(sample, event_id, Type) %>%
  count(sample, name = "total_sv_events") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_sv_events), sample)

sample_order <- sample_total_counts$sample
sample_order <- sample_order[sample_order %in% colnames(mat)]

# reorder heatmap columns
mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]


# ===============================
# SV frequency and labels (sample-level prevalence)
# ===============================
gene_freq <- rowSums(!is.na(mat) & mat != "")
gene_freq_pct <- round((gene_freq / ncol(mat)) * 100, 1)
gene_freq_labels <- paste0(gene_freq_pct, "%")
names(gene_freq_labels) <- rownames(mat)

# ===============================
# Bottom annotation: Source, Histology
# ===============================
annotation_df <- read.csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/Annotation.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

annotation_df$Sample <- trimws(annotation_df$Sample)
colnames(mat) <- trimws(colnames(mat))
rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$Sample
annotation_df <- annotation_df[colnames(mat), , drop = FALSE]

source_colors <- c(
  "Metastasis" = rgb(231, 138, 195, maxColorValue = 255),
  "Primary"    = rgb(255, 217, 47, maxColorValue = 255)
)

histology_colors <- c(
  "ILC"  = "#FF6B6B",
  "NST"  = "#4D79FF",
  "mDLC" = "#B07CC6"
)

bottom_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df[, c("Source", "Histology")],
  col = list(
    Source = source_colors,
    Histology = histology_colors
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  annotation_height = unit(c(1.2, 1.2), "cm"),
  which = "column"
)

# ===============================
# Order genes by prevalence (heatmap row order)
# ===============================
ordering <- gene_metadata %>%
  mutate(freq = gene_freq[OverlapGenes]) %>%
  arrange(desc(freq)) %>%
  pull(OverlapGenes)

ordering <- ordering[ordering %in% rownames(mat)]
mat <- mat[ordering, , drop = FALSE]
gene_freq_labels <- gene_freq_labels[ordering]

gene_metadata <- gene_metadata %>%
  filter(OverlapGenes %in% ordering) %>%
  arrange(match(OverlapGenes, ordering))
# ===============================
# Top annotation: per sample SV count (EVENT-LEVEL)
# ordered MAX -> MIN
# ===============================
sample_sv_counts <- df_top %>%
  distinct(sample, event_id, Type) %>%
  count(sample, Type, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(sample, Type = names(col_fun_bar), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(sample_sv_counts) <- sample_sv_counts$sample
sample_sv_counts$sample <- NULL
sample_sv_counts <- sample_sv_counts[colnames(mat), , drop = FALSE]
sample_sv_counts <- as.matrix(sample_sv_counts)

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  SVs = anno_barplot(
    sample_sv_counts,
    gp = gpar(fill = col_fun_bar),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.95,
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  ),
  annotation_height = unit(4, "cm"),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
)

# ===============================
# Right annotation: per-gene SV counts (EVENT-LEVEL)
# ===============================
sv_levels <- names(col_fun_bar)

gene_sv_counts_full <- df_top %>%
  distinct(OverlapGenes, sample, event_id, Type) %>%
  count(OverlapGenes, Type, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(OverlapGenes, Type = sv_levels, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(gene_sv_counts_full) <- gene_sv_counts_full$OverlapGenes
gene_sv_counts_full$OverlapGenes <- NULL

gene_sv_counts_full <- gene_sv_counts_full[ordering, sv_levels, drop = FALSE]
gene_sv_counts_full <- as.matrix(gene_sv_counts_full)

right_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SVs = anno_barplot(
    gene_sv_counts_full,
    gp = gpar(fill = col_fun_bar),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.95,
    axis_param = list(side = "bottom", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "bottom",
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  annotation_width = unit(2, "cm")
)

# ===============================
# Role & Prevalence annotations (LEFT)
# ===============================
role_colors <- c(
  Oncogene = "#FF4E42",
  TSG      = "#3B75AF",
  Dual     = "#F2B701",
  Other    = "#BBBBBB"
)

role_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Role = gene_metadata$cancer_role,
  col = list(Role = role_colors),
  annotation_width = unit(1.5, "cm")
)

left_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  freq = anno_text(
    gene_freq_labels,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
    just = "right",
    location = unit(1, "npc")
  ),
  annotation_width = unit(1.8, "cm")
)

# ===============================
# Heatmap
# ===============================
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "SV Type",
  col = col_fun_cell,
  na_col = "#E5E5E5",
  border = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_anno,
  left_annotation = c(role_anno, left_anno),
  right_annotation = right_anno,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
  row_title = "SV-Altered BRCA Genes",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    cell_value <- mat[i, j]
    if (is.na(cell_value) || cell_value == "") {
      cell_fill <- "#E5E5E5"
    } else {
      svs <- unique(str_split(cell_value, ";")[[1]])
      if (length(svs) == 1 && svs %in% names(col_fun_cell)) {
        cell_fill <- col_fun_cell[[svs]]
      } else {
        cell_fill <- col_fun_cell[["Multi-Hit"]]
      }
    }
    grid.rect(
      x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height,
      gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 3, fill = cell_fill)
    )
  }
)
draw(ht)
```

# ===============================
# Save heatmap (no legend)
# ===============================
png(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/IPM_TCGA_ICGC_BRCA_SVs_Heatmap_PlotOnly.png",
  width = 10, height = 16, units = "in", res = 300
)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

pdf(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/IPM_TCGA_ICGC_BRCA_SVs_Heatmap_PlotOnly.pdf",
  width = 12, height = 14
)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

# ===============================
# Save Combined Legend
# ===============================
sv_legend <- Legend(
  title = "SV Type",
  at = names(col_fun_cell),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(col_fun_cell))
)

role_legend <- Legend(
  title = "Gene Role",
  at = names(role_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(role_colors))
)

source_legend <- Legend(
  title = "Sample Source",
  at = names(source_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(source_colors))
)

histology_legend <- Legend(
  title = "Histology",
  at = names(histology_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(histology_colors))
)

combined_legend <- packLegend(
  sv_legend,
  role_legend,
  source_legend,
  histology_legend,
  direction = "vertical",
  column_gap = unit(1, "cm")
)

png(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/IPM_TCGA_ICGC_BRCA_SVs_Combined_Legend.png",
  width = 5, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300
)
grid.newpage()
draw(combined_legend)
dev.off()

pdf(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/IPM_TCGA_ICGC_BRCA_SVs_Combined_Legend.pdf",
  width = 5, height = 6
)
grid.newpage()
draw(combined_legend)
dev.off()

# ===============================
# Save Metadata Table
# ===============================
write.csv(
  gene_metadata,
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Heatmap_SV/IPM_TCGA_ICGC_BRCA_genes_with_roles.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
